_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); midstream signals

pit_profile.why: Commodity exposure (Targa Resources Corp. FY2019 10-K): Our primary natural gas gathering and processing arrangements that expose us to commodity price risk are our percent-of-proceeds arrangements. Distribution policy: 'even if our business experiences fluctuations in cash from operations due to seasonal and cyclical factors' (the boilerplate of the dividend policy, not a statement that the business is cyclical: the CHTR reading). Risk factor: 'Our cash flow is affected by supply and demand for natural gas and NGL products and by natural gas, NGL, crude oil and condensate prices, and decreases in these prices could adversely affect our results of operations and financial condition.'; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a midstream natural gas company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', ENERGY_TRANSITION to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining', EV to 'battery-electric vehicles displace ICE powertrains, auto parts suppliers and fuel retail': none names midstream energy but ENERGY_TRANSITION, whose oil, gas and coal reserves and refining a gatherer and processor does not hold (the BKR reading: the Targa Resources Corp. FY2019 10-K names no reserves of Targa's, and its refinery services are NGL balancing for refiners, 'In our refinery services business, we typically provide NGL balancing services through contractual arrangements with refiners to purchase and/or market propane and to supply butanes.'; the Channelview Splitter is a terminaling asset of the Petroleum Logistics business: 'Our Petroleum Logistics business owns and operates a storage and terminaling facility in Channelview, Texas, including a 35,000 Bbl/d nameplate capacity crude oil and condensate splitter (the “Channelview Splitter”).'); the 10-Ks' 'offshore' is the Gulf Coast and its waters, the Targa Resources Corp. FY2019 10-K does not name cloud, and no 10-K names e-commerce, streaming, electric vehicles or crypto), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here, with the greenhouse gas risk factor: 'Our and our customers’ operations are subject to a number of risks arising out of the threat of climate change (including legislation or regulation to address climate change) that could result in increased operating costs, limit the areas in which oil and natural gas production may occur, and reduce demand for the products and services we provide.' (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: EPS -55.1%/yr (worst year FY11-FY15, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -24.2%/yr (Q4 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 9.2-yr ex-FY10 ex-FY16 ex-FY17 ex-FY18 ex-FY19 median

BULL.desc: EPS +10.2%/yr (FY11-FY15 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +63.4%/yr (best 2-yr run FY11-FY15, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: TRGP (retrospective, 2020-03-06) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (89.2% downside to Bear $3 / +-21.0% upside to Bull $22) | Adj composite 2.55 vs market 3.14: gap -0.59 [OVERVALUED] | +142% above the EPP floor $12 (35x FY20E $0.33) | Conservative 2-yr case: -17.6% total (-8.8%/yr) | At 84.7x FY20E the 15% hurdle price $37 sits above the BULL case; Gathering and Processing +13.6% and Logistics and Marketing +100.4% operating margin in Q4 2019, forward revenues -4.8% (no FY20 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2019 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a midstream natural gas company on this date; none has dated evidence.
